triggers.symptom: Bars look distorted because axis starts at 100 instead of 0
triggers.action: Bar/Column charts encode magnitude by length and MUST start at 0. Line charts may use a zoomed baseline if labeled.

triggers.symptom: Overall conversion rises, yet every individual channel drops
triggers.action: Segment traffic weights before concluding improvement; shifting mix toward a high-converting channel skews the aggregate.

triggers.symptom: Need dynamic Profit Margin % that updates when slicers change
triggers.action: Use a DAX Measure (DIVIDE(SUM(Profit), SUM(Sales))) evaluated under filter context, never average row-level margins.

triggers.symptom: Clicking one chart accidentally filters a fixed Target Card
triggers.action: Select the source visual -> Format -> Edit Interactions -> set Target Card icon to None.

triggers.symptom: One trend line must switch between Sales, Profit, and Discount %
triggers.action: Create a Field Parameter slicer so one chart dynamically swaps measures without stacking duplicate visuals.

triggers.symptom: Bridge 2017 Profit to 2018 Profit across positive & negative drivers
triggers.action: Use Waterfall to show cumulative positive gains and negative drops between two period totals.

triggers.symptom: Plot Monthly Revenue (Crores) and Profit Margin (%) together
triggers.action: Use secondary Y-axis for Profit % so small percentages do not flatten near zero.

triggers.symptom: Unexpected (Blank) row appears in a Power BI visual
triggers.action: Check for Fact foreign keys missing from the Dimension table, or uncleaned trailing blank rows in Excel.

triggers.symptom: Wide Excel sheet has 12 separate month columns (Jan..Dec)
triggers.action: Unpivot month columns into tall Attribute (Month) + Value columns before modeling.

triggers.symptom: Navigation button does nothing in Power BI Desktop
triggers.action: In Desktop authoring mode, hold Ctrl + Click to test navigation buttons; Service users just single-click.

modules.title: M1: Visualisation & Chart Matrix
modules.summary: Core narrative logic, chart selection rules, and visual/statistical distortion traps.

nodes.label: Observation -> Insight -> Recommendation
nodes.short: Never stop at raw numbers; state why it happened and what to do.
bullets: Observation: What happened (e.g., North return rate hit 24% in Oct).
Insight: Causal driver (e.g., CoD footwear lacked mobile size charts).
Recommendation: Concrete action (e.g., Add mobile size-guide popup).
nodes.trap: Exam MCQs often ask you to pick the true Insight over a plain Observation or Action.

nodes.label: Chart Selection Matrix
nodes.short: Match the exact business question to its cleanest visual encoding.
bullets: Time trend (continuous) -> Line Chart; Category ranking -> Sorted Horizontal Bar.
Profit bridge (+/- drivers) -> Waterfall; Mix share % over time -> 100% Stacked Area.
2 continuous metrics + outliers -> Scatter Plot with Avg/Target reference lines.
nodes.trap: Avoid pie charts beyond 3-5 slices and never use a line chart across unordered categories.

nodes.label: Misleading Patterns & Traps
nodes.short: Zero-baseline bars, rate vs. count, and Simpson's Paradox.
bullets: Bar charts MUST start at 0; truncated Y-axes exaggerate small gaps.
Compare rates (%) rather than raw counts when store/region sizes differ.
Always segment aggregates to rule out Simpson's Paradox and confounding variables.
nodes.trap: Correlation on a dual-axis chart never proves causation without controlling confounders.

nodes.label: 60-30-10 Rule & Accessibility
nodes.short: Restrain color to make real alerts pop; never rely on red/green alone.
bullets: 60% neutral canvas, 30% structural surfaces, 10% purposeful accent/alert color.
Pair red/green deltas with directional arrows or +/- signs for color-blind readers.

modules.title: M2: Dashboard Architecture
modules.summary: From stakeholder requirements and data audit to MVP scoping, KPI cards, and hybrid layouts.

nodes.label: Why / What / How-When / Where
nodes.short: Separate Project Sponsors from daily Dashboard Users early.
bullets: Why: Concrete decision enabled. What: Exact KPIs, targets, and grain.
How/When/Where: Cadence (live vs. weekly) and device (wall TV vs. laptop).
Strategic (CEO) = periodic KPIs + targets; Operational = intraday exception queues.
nodes.trap: Building for the VP sponsor instead of daily frontline users creates shelfware.

nodes.label: Hybrid Architecture & Data Audit
nodes.short: Shared certified core metrics + department views; audit data before building.
bullets: Hybrid = 1 certified core overview (prevents metric drift) + tailored team pages.
Audit cadence, entity hygiene (Calcutta vs. Kolkata), and extraction bottlenecks.
MVP = High Value intersected with Immediate Feasibility (defer blocked PDFs to Phase 2).
nodes.trap: Never delay core Phase 1 dashboards waiting on one blocked external API.

nodes.label: 4-Part KPI Card & Hierarchy
nodes.short: Headline metric + benchmark + delta + micro-trend in top-left anchor.
bullets: 4 parts: Current Value (scaled cleanly) + Benchmark + Directional Delta + Trend.
Top-left Z/F anchor for primary KPIs; use Progressive Disclosure for detail.
Lock low-fidelity wireframes & sign-off before writing DAX.
nodes.trap: A raw number alone without target/prior comparison is not decision-ready.

modules.title: M3: Power BI Modeling & DAX
modules.summary: Power Query ETL hygiene, Star Schema modeling, and Calculated Columns vs. DAX Measures.

nodes.label: Power Query Hygiene
nodes.short: Clean junk rows, standardize labels, set types, and Unpivot upstream.
bullets: Remove top junk rows, promote headers, trim text, fix Date/Decimal types.
Unpivot wide month columns (Jan..Dec) into tall Month + Value columns.
Remove unused columns early to keep VertiPaq memory lean.
nodes.trap: Fixing data types or duplicates downstream in visuals leaves broken model joins.

nodes.label: Star Schema (Fact & Dimension)
nodes.short: Facts hold numeric events; Dimensions hold attributes (1:* single-direction).
bullets: FactSales (OrderDate, Sales, Profit, Qty) <- 1:* single-direction from DimProduct/DimCustomer/DimDate.
Dedicated DimDate table beats auto-date hierarchies for multi-fact time intelligence.
Hide technical foreign-key IDs in Report View.
nodes.trap: Avoid Many-to-Many bidirectional joins; they create ambiguous filter paths.

nodes.label: DAX Measures vs. Calculated Columns
nodes.short: Measures = dynamic filter context; Columns = static row-level buckets.
bullets: DAX Measure: Evaluated at query time under slicers; zero row RAM; mandatory for ratios.
Calculated Column: Evaluated at refresh (row context); use ONLY for slicer/axis buckets.
Always write explicit measures rather than dragging raw columns.
nodes.trap: Never average row-level Profit Margin %; compute DIVIDE(SUM(Profit), SUM(Sales)).

modules.title: M4 & M5: Interactivity & Service
modules.summary: Interactive controls, diagnostic visuals, QA sign-off, and Power BI Service publishing.

nodes.label: Field Params, Top N & Edit Interactions
nodes.short: Control what swaps, ranks, and isolates across every visual.
bullets: Field Parameters: One visual switches measures dynamically via slicer.
Top N Visual Filter: Dynamic Top 5/6 items inside active slicer context.
Edit Interactions: Set to None to protect fixed-scope / benchmark cards.
nodes.trap: Synced multi-year slicers can silently corrupt fixed-year (e.g. 2018-only) pages.

nodes.label: Combo, Waterfall & Quadrant Scatter
nodes.short: Isolate growth drivers and discount-driven margin leaks.
bullets: Combo Chart: Bars (Sales/Profit) + Secondary-Axis Line (Margin % / Discount %).
Scatter Matrix: Discount % vs. Profit Ratio % with Avg reference lines -> 4 quadrants.
QA Check: Verify conditional formatting signs (< vs <=, 0.15 vs 15) and default slicers.
nodes.trap: Testing navigation buttons in Power BI Desktop requires Ctrl + Click.

nodes.label: Reports vs. Dashboards & Pin Live Page
nodes.short: One Master Semantic Model; Pin Live Page keeps dashboard interactivity.
bullets: Report = multi-page, 1 semantic model (Desktop/Service).
Dashboard = single-page Service canvas pinning tiles from 1+ reports.
Pin Live Page retains slicers/cross-filtering; individual tiles are static links.
nodes.trap: Emailing .pbix files causes version sprawl; publish once to a shared Workspace.

traps.trap: Guessing blindly on MSQs (2 marks each)
traps.fix: Partial/negative scoring applies per question floored at 0: + (2/k) per right option, - (2/k) per wrong option. Never select options you are unsure of.

traps.trap: Starting a Bar/Column chart Y-axis above zero
traps.fix: Bars encode magnitude by length and MUST start at 0; only line charts can zoom with clear axis labels.

traps.trap: Confusing an Observation with an Insight
traps.fix: Observation = what happened (24% returns); Insight = why it happened (missing mobile size chart).

traps.trap: Trusting aggregate averages during mix shifts
traps.fix: Always check segment-level trends to catch Simpson's Paradox.

traps.trap: Using a Calculated Column for Profit Margin %
traps.fix: Use a DAX Measure (DIVIDE(SUM(Profit), SUM(Sales))) so ratios recalculate dynamically under slicers.

traps.trap: Ignoring unexpected (Blank) rows in Power BI visuals
traps.fix: Check unmatched Fact foreign keys missing in Dimension tables, or trailing blank Excel rows.

traps.trap: Fixed 2018-only charts changing when global Year slicers move
traps.fix: Lock page/visual filter to 2018 and adjust Sync Slicers + Edit Interactions.

traps.trap: Thinking page navigation buttons are broken in Power BI Desktop
traps.fix: Hold Ctrl + Click in Desktop authoring mode; single-click works after publishing to Service.

traps.trap: Confusing Power BI Reports with Service Dashboards
traps.fix: Reports are multi-page from 1 semantic model; Dashboards are 1-page Service canvases pinning tiles from 1+ reports.

traps.trap: Conditional formatting threshold sign mistakes (< vs <= or 0.15 vs 15)
traps.fix: Test zero and boundary values during pre-publish QA.
